description: This PHP class defines `EndpointGetOneResult`, a serializer class for API responses in version 2 of the OrangeHRM Core plugin. It extends `AbstractEndpointResult` and implements a `normalize` method that calls `normalizeObject`.

classes.name: EndpointGetOneResult
classes.description: A serializer class for API responses that extends `AbstractEndpointResult`. It provides a `normalize` method which returns a normalized version of the object.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized array representation of the object by calling `normalizeObject()`.
